TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR SERVICE PROVIDERS

Last Updated: March 1, 2026

Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully before registering as a Service Provider on the QuickFix platform. By submitting your application, you agree to be bound by these terms.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. ELIGIBILITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• You must be at least 18 years of age to register as a provider.
• You must provide valid government-issued identification.
• You must hold any licenses or certifications required for your service type.
• You must have legal authorization to work in your jurisdiction.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
2. ACCURATE INFORMATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• All business information provided must be accurate, current, and complete.
• You must immediately update any information that becomes outdated or inaccurate.
• Providing false information may result in immediate account suspension or termination.
• QuickFix reserves the right to verify all submitted information at any time.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
3. SERVICE QUALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• You agree to deliver services as advertised and described on your profile.
• You must maintain a professional standard of work at all times.
• Services must be completed within the agreed timeframe with the customer.
• You are responsible for bringing all necessary tools and materials.
• Any substandard work must be rectified at no additional cost to the customer.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
4. PROFESSIONAL CONDUCT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Treat all customers with respect and courtesy at all times.
• Do not engage in any form of harassment, discrimination, or abusive behavior.
• Maintain personal hygiene and present yourself professionally.
• Do not solicit customers for services outside the QuickFix platform.
• Do not share customer personal data with any third party.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
5. COMMISSION AND PAYMENTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• QuickFix charges a commission on each completed booking as per the current rate card.
• Commission rates are subject to change with 30 days advance notice.
• Payments will be processed within 3–5 business days after service completion.
• Any disputes regarding payments must be raised within 7 days of the transaction.
• QuickFix is not responsible for delays caused by banking institutions.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6. ACCOUNT SUSPENSION AND TERMINATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• QuickFix reserves the right to suspend or remove any provider account that violates these terms.
• Repeated customer complaints may lead to account suspension pending investigation.
• Fraudulent activity will result in immediate and permanent termination.
• Providers may appeal suspension decisions within 14 days via support channels.
• QuickFix may terminate any account with 30 days notice without cause.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
7. DATA PRIVACY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Your business profile and information may be displayed publicly on the platform.
• Customer contact details shared for booking purposes must not be misused.
• You consent to QuickFix collecting and processing your data per our Privacy Policy.
• ID documents are stored securely and only accessible to authorized QuickFix staff.
• You may request deletion of your data by contacting support@quickfix.app.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
8. EMERGENCY AND SAFETY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Misuse of the emergency service feature will result in immediate account removal.
• You must ensure your own safety and the safety of customers during service delivery.
• Any accidents on customer premises must be reported to QuickFix within 24 hours.
• You are solely responsible for maintaining appropriate insurance coverage.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
9. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• QuickFix acts as a platform facilitator and is not liable for disputes between providers and customers.
• All disputes should first be attempted to be resolved directly with the customer.
• Unresolved disputes may be escalated to QuickFix support for mediation.
• QuickFix's decision in mediated disputes is final and binding.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
10. MODIFICATIONS TO TERMS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• QuickFix reserves the right to modify these terms at any time.
• Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of new terms.
• Major changes will be communicated via email or in-app notification.

PROVIDER TERMS & CONDITIONS

Effective Date: January 1, 2025

By submitting a provider application on QuickFix, you agree to the following terms:

1. ELIGIBILITY
 • You must be 18 years or older.
 • You must possess the necessary skills and qualifications for the service category you apply for.
 • You must provide accurate and truthful information in this application.

2. SERVICE STANDARDS
 • You must deliver services as described and agreed upon with customers.
 • All work must meet professional quality standards.
 • You must arrive on time and communicate proactively with customers.
 • Any misrepresentation of your services may result in account suspension.

3. PLATFORM COMMISSION
 • QuickFix charges a platform commission on completed bookings.
 • Commission rates will be communicated upon approval of your application.
 • You agree to accept the commission structure in force at the time of booking.

4. CUSTOMER DATA & PRIVACY
 • You must respect the privacy of all customer information shared with you.
 • Customer contact details must only be used for service delivery purposes.
 • Sharing, selling, or misusing customer data is strictly prohibited.

5. PROFESSIONAL CONDUCT
 • You must maintain professional and respectful conduct at all times.
 • Harassment, discrimination, or abuse toward customers is grounds for immediate termination.
 • You must not solicit customers to transact outside the QuickFix platform.

6. ACCOUNT VIOLATIONS
 • Fraudulent activity, fake reviews, or any form of deception will lead to permanent removal.
 • Repeated complaints or low ratings may result in suspension pending review.
 • QuickFix reserves the right to remove any provider listing that violates these guidelines.

7. SAFETY & LIABILITY
 • You are responsible for your own safety and the safety of your tools and equipment.
 • QuickFix is not liable for injuries, damages, or losses arising from your services.
 • You agree to indemnify QuickFix against any claims arising from your conduct.

8. MODIFICATIONS
 • QuickFix may update these terms at any time.
 • Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

9. TERMINATION
 • Either party may terminate the provider relationship at any time.
 • QuickFix may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms without prior notice.

By checking the agreement box, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

For questions, contact: support@quickfix.app
